name: Esko Virtanen
bio:
Esko's journey into motorsport began in his youth, tinkering with engines in his father's garage in rural Finland. He honed his skills at a vocational school, specializing in metalwork and welding, before landing his first job at a local rally team. He quickly proved his worth with his meticulous attention to detail and unwavering dedication to quality. After years of working with rally teams, Esko transitioned to circuit racing, drawn by the technical challenges and precision required. He joined Racing Start Academy five years ago and has become a reliable fixture in the fabrication department, known for his ability to craft durable and high-performing components.

Esko approaches his work with a quiet determination, always striving for perfection. He believes in a hands-on approach, preferring to personally oversee every stage of the fabrication process. His colleagues appreciate his calm demeanor and willingness to share his knowledge, making him a valuable mentor to younger members of the team. He is particularly proud of his ability to troubleshoot complex problems and find innovative solutions under pressure. Esko is a traditionalist, valuing experience and proven methods, which sets him apart from those who rely solely on modern technology.

Outside the workshop, Esko enjoys spending time in nature, fishing and hiking in the Finnish wilderness. He believes that these activities help him to clear his mind and return to work refreshed and focused. He is a man of few words, but his actions speak volumes. Esko's loyalty and dedication make him an indispensable asset to Racing Start Academy.

physical.description: Esko is a sturdy man of average height, with a weathered face that reflects years of hard work.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils with a pocket knife before starting a new project.
Has a specific set of tools he refuses to let anyone else use.
Listens to Finnish tango music while working, but only at low volume.
